Func - Error Status to Error Cluster.vi

Owning Palette: FuncVI Development

Converts a Boolean error status, which some FuncVI support VIs return, to the standard LabVIEW error cluster.

Details

Click the parameters for more information

 

error status in specifies an input error status.
error status out indicates an output error status.
Error Cluster out indicates an error condition in the standard error cluster. This output provides standard error out functionality.
status indicates error status.
code contains error code.
source contains additional error information.

 

Func - Error Status to Error Cluster.vi - details

The VI is intended for use in FuncVIs.
